meaning:
συν-αντάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּגַע, פָּגַשׁ, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;]
to meet with: with dative of person(s), Luk.9:18, 37 22:10, Act.10:25, Heb.7:1, 10. Metaphorical, of events, to happen, befall (Ding. L., Plut., al.): Act.20:22.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
